craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 58. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 9. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: By expiations so, by gifts, by breath-controls and, purification having done, this rite and also initiation should perform without doubt.
l4.sanskrit_cite: prāyaścittaistathā dānaiḥ prāṇāyāmaiśca śodhanam kṛtvā vidhimimāṃ cāpi dīkṣāṃ kuryādaśaṅkitaḥ
